packageRules.description: Group grpc packages together with widen strategy. Inert today -- nothing here depends on grpc -- and kept against clingwrap taking such a dependency again, not as a live example to copy. clingwrap is a client project installed across a wide range of distributions, so the floor of a >= constraint is not raised on every minor release: a raised floor or an exact pin sends pip to a source build on the newest Pythons, which have no wheels for older grpcio releases.
